definition.name: One fresh captured guest and original finite two-client programme

steps.name: Prepare the normal captured compiler sandbox and pinned binding tool only
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-http-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
